title: Oct 7 Results + Oct 8 Preview: Sometimes the Diamond Doesn't Shine
summary: Tough 1-3 day on Oct 7, but we're back with the White Sox pick for Oct 8

content.value:
## Here's the Thing About Tough Days

Look, I'm not going to sugarcoat it—October 7 was rough. We went 1-3, hitting on just 25% of our picks. The kind of day that makes you want to double-check the model, grab a coffee, and remember that baseball has a way of humbling even the smartest predictions. But that's also what makes this beautiful game so captivating, right?

## The One Bright Spot

Our Dodgers pick came through with a 51% confidence call that hit perfectly. Sometimes that's how it goes—you trust the numbers, even when they're close, and they reward you. The Dodgers over the Braves was our lone victory in a sea of misses.

## What Went Wrong?

Here's what stings: even our highest confidence pick of the day—the Padres at 54%—didn't come through. The Yankees, sitting at 52%, stumbled against the Rays. And the White Sox, our coin-flip 50% call against the Guardians, went the wrong way. Three misses that all felt makeable, which is exactly the kind of day that tests your faith in the process.

But that's the thing about data-driven picks—you don't abandon ship after one stormy day. You trust the long game.

## Looking Ahead to October 8

So here we are again, dusting ourselves off and turning our attention to October 8. And wouldn't you know it—we're running it back with the White Sox. Same matchup, same venue, same confidence level at 50%.

content.value:
## The Pitching Matchup to Watch

Parker Messick takes the mound for Cleveland while Hagen Smith gets the ball for Chicago. It's another tight one—a true toss-up according to our model. The White Sox are at home, and sometimes that home crowd energy makes all the difference in these October battles.

Is it bold to go back to the well after missing this exact pick yesterday? Maybe. But the beauty of the model is that it doesn't hold grudges or second-guess itself based on emotions. It just crunches the numbers and tells us what it sees.

## The Bottom Line

Yesterday hurt, there's no way around it. A 1-3 record isn't what we wanted to write about today. But October baseball is unpredictable, passionate, and filled with moments that remind us why we love this game.

We'll be back tomorrow with the White Sox pick, trusting the process and hoping the diamond shines a little brighter for us. Because that's the thing about baseball—every day is a new game, and redemption is always just one pitch away.

author: Hana
